Hedging US Growth Stocks

Tan Kai Xian

Gavekal Research | 12 Oct 2026

US growth stocks have proved remarkably resilient, with the MSCI US growth index generally outperforming its value counterpart since 2007. The surge in bond yields in 2022 briefly reversed this trend, but growth stocks regained the upper hand in 2023. Given the jump in oil prices and US bond yields this year, one might have expected a repeat of 2022. Not so. The MSCI US growth index has lagged the value index by just 3.7pp so far this year. But when everything is going well, prudent investors look for potential pitfalls. So, what could derail the strength of US growth stocks, and how can one hedge against these risks?
